text:
This is a square white plate, probably about 20-22 cm across. On it are about 2 bacon strips, several pieces of French toast or fried bread (roughly 6-7 chunks), and about 4 strawberry pieces.

Mass estimate:
- Bacon, 2 strips cooked: about 15 g, ~80 kcal
- Bread pieces, about 7 chunks at roughly 15 g each: about 100 g, ~250 kcal, allowing for fried or egg-soaked bread
- Strawberries, about 4 halves or pieces: about 50 g, ~15 kcal

Total is about 165 g and about 345 kcal.
